desc.p: Assigns each SNOMED CT vaccine product a default body site for synthetic immunization records. The site is not a property of the vaccine. It is invented for the SYNDERAI synthetic data so that a generated immunization record looks like a real one, and it is chosen to be plausible rather than to state a fact: a real administration site is decided by the person giving the injection and is recorded per event. Nothing here may be read as a clinical recommendation. The relationship is relatedto throughout, because no equivalence is claimed: the target does not denote the same thing as the source, it names the site at which the synthetic data will record the vaccine as having been given. Source is the value set Vaccine Product extensional (SNOMED) (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.11.10), target the three body structures collected in 2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.11.17. 20 rows. The route of administration is a different matter and is stated separately in the concept map Vaccine to route of administration (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.24.7); unlike the site it follows from the vaccine and is not invented.
